checks.name: checkpoint-integrity
checks.guarantee: Disclosed fields match signed ordered checkpoints; hidden fields are not checked

checks.name: evidence-validation
checks.guarantee: Malformed, tampered or insufficient disclosed data is not accepted

limits: RPC data is trusted; two agreeing providers are not an independent consensus proof.
Session signatures authenticate claimed observations, not HTTPS source truth or a complete history.
The deployed wallet enforces request/quote hashes and financial scope, not the entire session root.
Merchant receipts do not sign payment amount, request body or result body.
